outcome: order of appearance of fetal heart rate abnormalities
cohort: 132 term neonates born between 2018 and 2020 with metabolic acidemia, excluding those with congenital anomalies or twin pregnancies.
finding: In cases of metabolic acidemia at term, gradually evolving hypoxia was the most frequent situation, with decelerations appearing as the first anomaly, though the sequence of fetal heart rate modifications was variable.
